extensions.name: rpi-mcp-adapter
extensions.description: MCP client adapter: single `mcp` proxy tool with lazy server lifecycle (port of pi-mcp-adapter @ v2.24.0)
extensions.descriptionZh: MCP 客户端适配器:单个 `mcp` 代理工具,懒连接服务器生命周期(pi-mcp-adapter @ v2.24.0 移植)。

extensions.name: rpi-smart-fetch
extensions.description: Fingerprinted web fetch extension: `web_fetch`/`batch_web_fetch` tools with browser-grade TLS/HTTP2 emulation (wreq), readability extraction (dom_smoothie [VARIANT]) with a 1:1 DOM fallback chain, five output formats, a structured error model, streaming progress (toolUpdate) and ComponentTree renderers.
extensions.descriptionZh: 指纹化网页抓取:`web_fetch`/`batch_web_fetch` 工具,浏览器级 TLS/HTTP2 指纹模拟(wreq)、readability 正文提取(dom_smoothie)与 1:1 DOM 回退链、五种输出格式、结构化错误模型、流式进度(toolUpdate)与组件树渲染。

extensions.name: rpi-statusline
extensions.description: Claude Code-compatible script statusline: configure a shell command in settings.json, feed it session JSON (model, context usage, cost, effort) on stdin, render its stdout as the footer.
extensions.descriptionZh: Claude Code 兼容的脚本式自定义 statusline:在 settings.json 配一条 shell 命令,把会话数据(模型/上下文占用/费用/思考档位)以 CC 契约 JSON 喂给其 stdin,用其 stdout 渲染 footer。

extensions.name: rpi-subagents
extensions.description: Delegation extension: single `subagent` tool that spawns focused child rpi sessions with per-agent prompts, tool allowlists and depth limits; composite tasks/steps runs (ADR-0018), background async runs (ADR-0019), model fallback chains.
extensions.descriptionZh: 子代理委派:单个 `subagent` 工具派生专注的子 rpi 会话,支持 per-agent 提示词、工具白名单与深度限制;组合 tasks/steps 运行、后台异步运行、模型回退链。
